g.text: one per kernel (x8): 16 signed 8x8 products, 2-stage adder tree, Leaky ReLU, horizontal pair sum
byte k of win and kern goes to multiplier k (net labels win[k], kern[k]); all arithmetic is signed

name = net label (same name, same net)
